_doc: Places that must be recognisable. Each one is linked to its real footprint by an OSM element; 'facts' are what the model must show, each with where it was checked. 'verified' flips to true only after a side-by-side check against a reference view.

landmarks.name: Bar-Hôtel-Restaurant Le Central
facts: three storeys, hipped tile roof, white render, teal-green shutters, wrought-iron guards on some upper windows
east face (toward the Place): shop window and door with steps; 'BAR-HOTEL-RESTAURANT' over 'Le Central' in green
north face (along the river): 'BAR - HOTEL - RESTAURANT' in green letters above the ground floor
tabac carotte, Gold, PMU and FDJ signs stacked at the north-east corner

one-storey annex on the river bank (BD TOPO BATIMENT...1067): glazed veranda with small panes and a red-brown lower wall, 'RESTAURATION RAPIDE / PIZZAS KEBAB' sign; at its east end a terrace with tables, a white-framed awning and a black wrought-iron railing over the Ornain
tricolour bunting on the railing along the water, a lamp post hung with red geraniums at the corner
sources: user photos 2026-09-25: corner view, terrace, business card (clipboard)

landmarks.name: Mairie (Hôtel de Ville)
facts: CONFIRMED by user photo: 'HOTEL DE VILLE' on three raised plaques above the first floor
ochre render with pale stone quoins and window surrounds; hipped brown-red tile roof with chimneys
four bays: ground floor = green arched door + three windows; first floor = four tall windows with green frames; attic = four small windows
flower boxes (pink, white, red petunias) under the first-floor and ground-floor windows; two green wall lamps
a wide flight of stone steps up from the square, with a band of stepped stone cubes on its right
monument aux morts to the right of the steps: stone pillar with the Cross of Lorraine, ball finial, painted poilu in horizon blue holding a shield, lavender bed around it
sources: user photo 2026-09-25 (clipboard): mairie facade, steps and monument

landmarks.name: Tour de Gondrecourt (Musée Lorrain du Cheval)
facts: round 15th-century tower in rough grey limestone, unrendered
steep conical roof of brown tiles with an overhang, a flag on top
LiDAR HD: wall top about 16.5 m, roof tip 22.6 m above the ground at the tower (BD TOPO's 2 m roof rise is wrong for a cone)
BD TOPO: its own 21-sided footprint, radius 4.3-5.0 m
street side: small kiosk with a tiled pyramid roof, an old lantern, low wall with pillars, information panel, bench, woodpile
sources: user photos 2026-09-25: from the lower town, from the street beside it, Street View Apr 2026

landmarks.name: Pharmacie de l'Ornain
facts: beige render, teal shutters, wrought-iron balconies on the first floor
teal cross and 'PHARMACIE DE L'ORNAIN' lettering, green LED cross on a bracket

landmarks.name: Église de la Nativité-de-la-Vierge
facts: pale limestone, unrendered; 11th-century, listed monument historique 1970
west front on the Place de l'Église: pointed-arch portal with a red door, rose window above, stone cross on the gable
square bell tower behind the front, paired arched louvred openings, a clock, a steep four-sided slate spire with a cross and weathervane
LiDAR HD: spire tip 24.2 m above ground at (-5.2, 132.3); tower about 7 m square; nave roof about 11-12 m
sources: user Street View capture 2026-09-25 (11 Rue de l'Église, May 2026)

landmarks.name: Monument aux morts
facts: stone pillar with the Cross of Lorraine and a ball finial
painted poilu in horizon blue holding a shield, on the pedestal in front
lavender and grasses around it
beside the steps up to the mairie

landmarks.name: Ancien tribunal (Musée Lorrain du Cheval)
facts: pale grey-cream render, three rows of plain windows, hipped brown tile roof
lower wing on its west side with an orange tile roof

landmarks.name: La Carpière (salle socio-culturelle) and its park
facts: single-storey hall, white render, flat roof with a dark top band, orange frame round a glazed entrance, paved forecourt with benches
park between the hall and the Rue du Général Leclerc: lawn, rows of stone slabs set in the grass, playground with wooden play structures, information panel, weeping willow
along the street: low limestone wall with lavender and tall grasses in a strip at its foot, tall blue lamp posts
car park beside the hall; the old railway viaduct crosses the street to the west
sources: user Street View captures 2026-09-25 (7 views from the Rue du Général Leclerc)

landmarks.name: Carrefour Contact
facts: LiDAR HD: the store is in the tall pediment building (12.7 m; BD TOPO records 4.3 m)
north door on the car park: green panel with a fruit mural, lettering, arched entrance, red banner
west door on the Rue de la Grande Fontaine by the river: pediment with an oculus, 'Carrefour contact' lettering, green annex
the two doors communicate: you can walk through the store (interior invented)
sources: user Street View capture May 2026 from the Rue de la Grande Fontaine

landmarks.name: Crédit Agricole Lorraine
facts: two storeys, pale roughcast, hipped tile roof
wide dark windows with pale striped film and 'CRÉDIT AGRICOLE / LORRAINE'
small tiled canopy over the entrance with the white name sign, green CA logo
hedge and a stone trough on the corner, blue lamp posts

landmarks.name: Boulangerie La Mie Mado
facts: at the north end of Le Central's bridge, at the river end of a grey-white house
yellow fascia 'Boulangerie · Pâtisserie' (Festival), blue mosaic band, green board 'LA MIE MADO 03-29-92-01-33', white shopfront, round hanging sign; garage doors along the rest

landmarks.name: Tall house with blue shutters, 14 D32
facts: three storeys of dressed limestone, blue louvred shutters, slate mansard roof with dormers
arched ground-floor openings with blue doors; cornice under the roof
sources: user Street View captures of the Place, Apr 2026

landmarks.name: École primaire publique La Petite Meusienne (maternelle)
facts: two storeys, white, continuous ribbons of windows, low hipped brown roof, tricolour over the door
red school barriers along the Rue du Panorama
BD TOPO merges the whole school into ...0570; its east wing along the Rue du Panorama is the photographed block

landmarks.name: École: courtyard block
facts: white, grey metal barrel roof (drawn as a low hip), three portholes on the street end, yellow letter box

landmarks.name: Collège du Val d'Ornois
facts: long two-storey block, cream render, stone base, brown tile roof, tall square chimney
windows with white roller shutters half down; green mesh fence; flat grey annex by the car park
